title: Functional linear regression from sparse to dense designs: a pooling-ridge method and minimax optimality
abstract: arXiv:2608.25468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional data analysis is an important statistical field that treats data as random functions. In practice, the random functions are often not fully observed but instead measured at discrete times. While simpler problems, such as mean and covariance estimation, have been widely studied for discretely observed data, optimal estimation of linear regression for this data type has remained unsolved for over two decades. To tackle this fundamental challenge, we propose a novel approach, referred to as pooling ridge estimation, which combines the advantages of pooling strategy and RKHS-based method by incorporating the unbiased estimation of operators based on discretely observed measurements from all subjects. This unified estimation framework enables us to achieve minimax optimality in prediction risk in arbitrary sampling schemes ranging from sparse to dense designs, for both scalar-on-function and function-on-function regression models

translated_title: 从稀疏到密集设计的函数线性回归：一种池化岭方法及其极小极大最优性
translated_abstract: 函数数据分析是一个重要的统计领域，它将数据视为随机函数。在实践中，随机函数通常不是完全观测到的，而是在离散时间点上测量的。虽然更简单的问题，如均值和协方差估计，已被广泛研究用于离散观测数据，但此类数据类型的线性回归最优估计在二十多年来仍未得到解决。为了应对这一基本挑战，我们提出了一种新方法，称为池化岭估计，它通过结合基于所有受试者离散观测算子的无偏估计，融合了池化策略和基于RKHS方法的优势。这种统一的估计框架使我们能够在从稀疏到密集设计的任意采样方案中，针对标量对函数和函数对函数回归模型，实现预测风险的极小极大最优性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种池化岭估计方法，首次实现了从稀疏到密集设计下函数线性回归预测风险的极小极大最优性，解决了该领域二十多年的未解难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a pooling-ridge estimation method that achieves minimax optimality in prediction risk for functional linear regression under arbitrary sampling designs from sparse to dense, resolving a two-decade-old open problem.
